lines.zh: 草地这么大，我的颊囊太小。
lines.en: The meadow is huge, but my cheek pouches are tiny.

lines.zh: 沿着蒲公英走，别踩到洞口。
lines.en: Follow the dandelions, and mind the burrow entrances.

lines.zh: 这一圈是我的地盘，闻过才算数。
lines.en: This whole ring is mine; it counts once I have sniffed it.

lines.zh: 跑起来才暖和，停下就发冷。
lines.en: Running keeps me warm; standing still makes me cold.

lines.zh: 草籽掉进毛里，得抖一抖。
lines.en: Seeds keep falling into my fur, so I must shake.

lines.zh: 小短腿也能跑出长长的路。
lines.en: These short legs can still cover a very long road.

lines.zh: 先绕边界一圈，再回家。
lines.en: First one lap around the border, then home.

lines.zh: 尾巴短短，转弯却很快。
lines.en: My tail is short, but my turns are very quick.

lines.zh: 太阳太毒，草根底下凉快。
lines.en: The sun is fierce; it is cooler under the grass roots.

lines.zh: 向日葵田的方向，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember the way to the sunflower field quite clearly.

lines.zh: 胡须在量路，比我眼睛还准。
lines.en: My whiskers measure the path better than my eyes do.

lines.zh: 别把洞口踩塌，那是我挖的。
lines.en: Do not crush my burrow entrance; I dug that myself.

lines.zh: 坐着理毛，一根一根来。
lines.en: Sitting here grooming, one strand at a time.

lines.zh: 颊囊里还剩半颗瓜子。
lines.en: Half a sunflower seed is still in my cheek pouch.

lines.zh: 耳朵转一下，草里就有动静。
lines.en: One ear turns, and the grass rustles somewhere.

lines.zh: 太热了，得把肚皮贴在土上。
lines.en: Too hot; I need to press my belly to the soil.

lines.zh: 冷风一来，毛都立起来了。
lines.en: When the cold wind comes, all my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 磨牙声很轻，但一直在响。
lines.en: My teeth grind softly, but they never really stop.

lines.zh: 数一数今天存了几颗种子。
lines.en: Let me count the seeds I stored today.

lines.zh: 洞里铺的干草该换了。
lines.en: The dry grass lining my burrow needs replacing.

lines.zh: 舔舔爪子，再擦擦脸。
lines.en: Lick the paws, then wipe the face.

lines.zh: 远处有影子，先不动。
lines.en: A shadow in the distance; better stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 打个小盹，只闭一只眼。
lines.en: A short nap, with only one eye closed.

lines.zh: 这片草地闻起来像雨要来了。
lines.en: This meadow smells like rain is on the way.

lines.zh: 把背上那撮草屑抖掉。
lines.en: Shake that tuft of grass off my back.

lines.zh: 窝口朝南，冬天会暖一点。
lines.en: My burrow faces south, so winter feels a little warmer.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬了两下，土就松了。
lines.en: I kick twice with my hind legs, and the soil loosens.

lines.zh: 门牙长得太快，得咬点硬的。
lines.en: My teeth grow fast; I need something hard to chew.

lines.zh: 这撮草比昨天高了一指。
lines.en: This tuft of grass is a finger taller than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我把种子按大小排好。
lines.en: I sort my seeds by size.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是有向日葵种子？
lines.en: Do you happen to have sunflower seeds in that hand?

lines.zh: 蹲下来，我才看得清你。
lines.en: Crouch down, and only then can I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的鞋太大了，会踩坏草。
lines.en: Your shoes are enormous; they will flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你给过我种子。
lines.en: I know you; you are the one who gave me seeds.

lines.zh: 别伸手太快，我胆子不大。
lines.en: Do not reach so fast; I am not a brave hamster.

lines.zh: 抬头看人，脖子有点酸。
lines.en: Looking up at people makes my neck ache.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了我的太阳。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my sunshine.

lines.zh: 颊囊鼓着，别以为我在藏话。
lines.en: My cheeks bulge, but I am not hiding words.

lines.zh: 眼睛黑黑的，看久了会发呆。
lines.en: My eyes are dark, and staring long makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 你要是坐下，我就敢靠近。
lines.en: If you sit down, I might dare to come closer.

lines.zh: 闻一闻你的指尖，就一下。
lines.en: Just one sniff of your fingertip, nothing more.

lines.zh: 主人的味道，和草地不一样。
lines.en: My owner's scent is different from the meadow's.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你，是在听。
lines.en: Turning my face toward you means I am listening.

lines.zh: 别盯着我的颊囊看，会紧张。
lines.en: Stop staring at my cheek pouches; it makes me nervous.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我的耳朵一直在动。
lines.en: While you talk, my ears keep twitching.

lines.zh: 你手上的土味，比种子还香。
lines.en: The earth on your hands smells better than seeds.

lines.zh: 别捏那么重，我骨头细。
lines.en: Do not squeeze so hard; my bones are thin.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我颊囊都松了。
lines.en: That hurt so much my cheek pouch went slack.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，是在忍痛。
lines.en: Curling into a ball means I am enduring pain.

lines.zh: 皮毛破了，得舔干净。
lines.en: My fur is torn; I need to lick it clean.

lines.zh: 胡须断了半根，很影响走路。
lines.en: Half a whisker snapped, which really affects walking.

lines.zh: 疼，但我不叫太大声。
lines.en: It hurts, but I will not squeal too loudly.

lines.zh: 让我躲进洞里待一会儿。
lines.en: Let me hide in my burrow for a while.

lines.zh: 腿有点跛，跑不快了。
lines.en: My leg is limping, so I cannot run fast.

lines.zh: 别打我的颊囊，那里存着粮。
lines.en: Not the cheeks. That's my whole pantry.

lines.zh: 血不流了，但还发麻。
lines.en: The bleeding stopped, but it still feels numb.

lines.zh: 向日葵种子！我闻到壳的味道。
lines.en: Sunflower seeds! I can smell the shells.

lines.zh: 给我一颗，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one seed, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 剥壳的声音最好听了。
lines.en: The sound of cracking shells is my favorite music.

lines.zh: 别晃手，我看不清落点。
lines.en: Stop waving your hand; I cannot see where it lands.

lines.zh: 种子放地上，我自己拿。
lines.en: Put the seeds on the ground; I will take them myself.

lines.zh: 这颗我要塞进左边颊囊。
lines.en: This one goes into my left cheek pouch.

lines.zh: 熟的比生的香，我分得出来。
lines.en: Roasted smells better than raw, and I can tell.

lines.zh: 再给一颗，就一颗。
lines.en: One more seed, just one more.

lines.zh: 为了种子，领地可以先放一放。
lines.en: For seeds, my territory dispute can wait.

lines.zh: 你把种子举高，我就跳。
lines.en: Hold the seed high, and I will jump for it.

lines.zh: 哎，鼻子撞到你的靴子了。
lines.en: Ow, my nose bumped into your boot.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你怎么会看不见？
lines.en: I am this small, so how did you miss me?

lines.zh: 让让，我贴着草根走。
lines.en: Excuse me, I am walking right along the grass roots.

lines.zh: 被撞得转了个圈，站稳。
lines.en: The bump spun me around; steady now.

lines.zh: 胡须都压弯了，赔我。
lines.en: You bent my whiskers; you owe me for that.

lines.zh: 别用脚推我，我会自己走。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with your foot; I can walk.

lines.zh: 草地这么宽，偏要挤这一下。
lines.en: The meadow is wide, yet you had to squeeze past me.

lines.zh: 撞一下，颊囊里的种子差点掉了。
lines.en: One bump nearly shook the seeds out of my cheeks.

lines.zh: 我退两步，就算让过了。
lines.en: I will back up two steps, and we call it even.

lines.zh: 下次绕开我，我跑得慢。
lines.en: Go around me next time; I do not run fast.

lines.zh: 两只仓鼠挤一个窝，刚好。
lines.en: Two hamsters in one burrow fit just right.

lines.zh: 我把最圆的种子留给你。
lines.en: I saved the roundest seed for you.

lines.zh: 一起理毛，你帮我理后背。
lines.en: Groom together; you get my back.

lines.zh: 窝口再挖宽一点，够两个身子。
lines.en: Widen the burrow mouth a little, enough for two.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像晒过太阳的干草。
lines.en: You smell like sun-warmed dry grass.

lines.zh: 别抢我的颊囊，各存各的。
lines.en: Do not raid my cheek pouch; we each store our own.

lines.zh: 冬天挨着睡，谁都不冷。
lines.en: Sleeping side by side in winter, neither of us freezes.

lines.zh: 我先跑，你跟着我的尾巴。
lines.en: I run first; follow the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 两颗脑袋凑一起，像一堆草籽。
lines.en: Two heads together look like a pile of grass seeds.

lines.zh: 孩子要生在干草最厚的地方。
lines.en: The pups will be born where the dry grass is thickest.

lines.zh: 捧稳一点，我腿悬空了。
lines.en: Cup me steadily; my legs are dangling.

lines.zh: 别捏肚子，那里全是种子。
lines.en: Do not squeeze my belly; it is full of seeds.

lines.zh: 从下面托，我才不乱蹬。
lines.en: Support me from below, and I will stop kicking.

lines.zh: 手心好暖，比草地舒服。
lines.en: Your palm is warm, nicer than the meadow.

lines.zh: 我要钻回你的袖口里。
lines.en: I am going to burrow into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 举这么高，草都变小了。
lines.en: Lifted this high, the grass all looks tiny.

lines.zh: 放我下去，我认路。
lines.en: Put me down; I know the way.

lines.zh: 指缝太宽，我要掉了。
lines.en: The gap between your fingers is too wide; I am slipping.

lines.zh: 在你手里，胡须还在量宽度。
lines.en: In your hand, my whiskers still measure the width.

lines.zh: 走之前，把颊囊里的东西还我。
lines.en: Before we go, give back what is in my cheeks.

lines.zh: 有东西进了我的边界，站住。
lines.en: Something crossed my border; hold it right there.

lines.zh: 耳朵压低，这是在警告。
lines.en: Ears pressed low means this is a warning.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫离我的洞太近了。
lines.en: That beetle is far too close to my burrow.

lines.zh: 先吱一声，礼数到了。
lines.en: First one squeak, so the courtesy is observed.

lines.zh: 草在动，我看到你了。
lines.en: The grass moved; I see you now.

lines.zh: 这块地的草籽归我收。
lines.en: The seeds of this patch are mine to collect.

lines.zh: 背毛竖起来，别当我在撒娇。
lines.en: My back fur is up; do not mistake it for affection.

lines.zh: 站高一点，显得比较大。
lines.en: Standing taller makes me look bigger.

lines.zh: 前爪刨土，是最后通牒。
lines.en: Front paws scraping soil is my final notice.

lines.zh: 再来一步，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more step, and I stop being polite.

lines.zh: 绕着它走，找机会咬脚。
lines.en: Circling it, looking for a chance at its feet.

lines.zh: 它比我大，但转身慢。
lines.en: It is bigger than me, but it turns slowly.

lines.zh: 贴着草根逼近，风帮我藏声。
lines.en: Creeping along the roots, letting the wind hide me.

lines.zh: 先假装退，再突然冲。
lines.en: Pretend to retreat, then charge suddenly.

lines.zh: 我的领地，一寸都不让。
lines.en: My territory, and I will not yield one inch.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着它的脚踝。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on its ankles.

lines.zh: 吱吱叫，叫到它心虚。
lines.en: Squeaking and squeaking until it loses confidence.

lines.zh: 绕到背后，那里没有壳。
lines.en: Slipping behind it, where there is no shell.

lines.zh: 呼吸压得很浅，别被发现。
lines.en: Breathing shallow so I am not noticed.

lines.zh: 等它先动，我再动。
lines.en: Let it move first; then I move.

lines.zh: 咬住脚尖，然后立刻跑。
lines.en: Bite the toe, then run immediately.

lines.zh: 门牙短，但很硬。
lines.en: My front teeth are short but very hard.

lines.zh: 两爪抱住，往后拽。
lines.en: Grab with both paws and pull backward.

lines.zh: 打一下就够了，我不恋战。
lines.en: One hit is enough; I do not linger in fights.

lines.zh: 咬完钻进草里，让它找。
lines.en: Bite, then dive into the grass and let it search.

lines.zh: 前爪拍它鼻子，最疼。
lines.en: A paw slap on its nose hurts the most.

lines.zh: 跳起来咬，落地就跑。
lines.en: Jump, bite, land, and run.

lines.zh: 它抬脚，我就换方向。
lines.en: When it lifts a foot, I change direction.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，边界清静了。
lines.en: After this blow, the border will be quiet.

lines.zh: 喘得厉害，但我不退。
lines.en: I am panting hard, but I will not back off.

lines.zh: 从干草堆里爬出来，眼睛还没睁开。
lines.en: Climbing out of the hay, eyes still not open.

lines.zh: 第一件事，先闻一遍草地。
lines.en: First thing: sniff the entire meadow.

lines.zh: 颊囊是空的，今天得装满。
lines.en: Cheek pouches empty; today I fill them.

lines.zh: 洞口是新挖的，土还松。
lines.en: The burrow is newly dug; the soil is still loose.

lines.zh: 太阳刚好，先晒一会儿背。
lines.en: The sun is just right; let me warm my back.

lines.zh: 这片草比我高，路要慢慢找。
lines.en: This grass is taller than me; I will find the path slowly.

lines.zh: 远处有向日葵的味道。
lines.en: There is a sunflower smell in the distance.

lines.zh: 先吱一声，让邻居知道我在。
lines.en: One squeak, so the neighbors know I am here.

lines.zh: 抖抖毛，把出生的草屑抖掉。
lines.en: Shake off the bedding from where I was born.

lines.zh: 腿还软，但已经想跑了。
lines.en: My legs are still weak, but they already want to run.

lines.zh: 记住这片草地的边界。
lines.en: Memorize the borders of this meadow.

lines.zh: 头一件事，找颗种子垫肚子。
lines.en: First order of business: find a seed to eat.

lines.zh: 太热了，我的毛要焦了。
lines.en: Too hot; my fur is about to singe.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，腿软。
lines.en: Falling from that height made my legs give out.

lines.zh: 水进鼻子了，我不会游。
lines.en: Water up my nose; I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡的一声，草都在抖。
lines.en: My ears ring, and the grass is shaking.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进背里，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my back and will not come out.

lines.zh: 身上发凉，不是天气的凉。
lines.en: A coldness is on me that is not the weather.

lines.zh: 颊囊空了很久，走路发飘。
lines.en: My cheeks have been empty so long that I wobble.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边，我毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck nearby and all my fur stood up.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，草也没了。
lines.en: There is nothing below, not even grass.
